notes.urn:cts:latinLit:tmp1244.tmp1244.opp-lat: 'tel' is read as 'vel'. The sense of 'caragios' (a kind of diviner or sorcerer) is uncertain.

nodes.text: It is not permitted to resort to soothsayers or to look to auguries, nor to look to *caragi* [diviners or charm-makers], nor to the lots which they call 'of the saints', or those which they make of wood or of bread; but whatever a person wants to do, let him do it all in the name of the Lord.
